def transform(grid):
    # Rotate the source grid by 180 degrees to form the base tile.
    base = [list(reversed(row)) for row in reversed(grid)]
    # Mirror the tile horizontally, then vertically, with the middle band
    # reflected between two normal copies.
    horizontal = [row + list(reversed(row)) for row in base]
    return horizontal + list(reversed(horizontal)) + horizontal
